overview: The AMG C 63 S E PERFORMANCE is the only plug-in hybrid C-Class variant sold in the US (the regular C-Class is offered as C 300 MHEV only — no regular C 350e for US). Combines the world's most powerful production 2.0L turbocharged four-cylinder (469 hp on its own) with a rear-axle 201-hp electric motor and a 6.1 kWh battery for 671 hp / 752 lb-ft total. 0-60 in 3.3 sec. Designed for performance, not efficiency — minimal EV range (~7 mi). The standard C 350e PHEV is sold in Europe but not the US. Sources: https://www.mbusa.com/en/vehicles/class/c-class/sedan ; https://www.autonation.com/vehicle-research/2025-mercedes-benz-c-class-trim-levels
